query: SELECT la.id, la.leadId, la.agencyId, la.userId, la.type, la.subject, la.content, la.createdAt, l.firstName, l.lastName, l.phone, l.email FROM lead_activities la LEFT JOIN leads l ON la.leadId = l.id WHERE la.type IN ('sms', 'email') AND la.userId IS NOT NULL ORDER BY la.createdAt DESC LIMIT 20;
